environment.description: Provider binary executed inside a Kubernetes pod managed by Atlantis (v0.24.x) on EKS 1.28. Pod spec includes a custom annotation referencing a RuntimeDefault-derived seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/tf-provider-hardened.json. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO as defaultAction with an explicit allowlist of syscalls needed for Terraform provider gRPC communication (read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, clone, futex, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_pwait, nanosleep, openat, getpid, gettid, tgkill, exit_group, sigaltstack, arch_prctl, set_robust_list, sched_getaffinity). Notably absent from the allowlist: execve, execveat, fork, vfork, socket, connect, sendto, recvfrom, bind, listen, accept, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev. The pod's securityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. The service account has no IRSA role attached.

config.network_policy: default-deny egress (CoreDNS and Terraform state backend only)
